queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network operations" OR NetOps "network configuration" OR "config generation" "intent to configuration" "intent-to-config" prompt engineering
queries.rationale: Discover core literature on using LLMs to translate operator intent or natural language into network configurations or change plans (foundational NetOps-LLM works and prompt-based approaches).
Locate papers and preprints that study iteration/repair loops where models generate configs and then validate/repair them—central to reliability/guarded generation.

queries.query: network configuration verification "formal verification" "reachability" "header space analysis" Batfish Anteater "config verification"
queries.rationale: Collect the deterministic/formal verification literature and tools used to check correctness of generated configurations (to evaluate validators and metrics).

queries.query: AIOps "LLM" "network" "closed-loop" "autonomous network operations" agentic "automated network management"
queries.rationale: Find work on closed-loop automation, agentic AIOps, and autonomous NetOps workflows to position agentic researcher systems and identify operational scenarios and failure modes.
Target architectures combining generation plus external verification tools (verifier-assisted / tool-assisted paradigms) relevant to safe NetOps generation.

queries.query: benchmarks "NetOps" "LLM" "network benchmark" "OpsEval" "6G-Bench" "TSNBench" evaluation dataset network operations
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmarks, datasets and evaluation suites that claim to evaluate LLMs / generative models on networking or operational tasks (to assess benchmark validity and gaps).

queries.query: metrics "operational correctness" "policy compliance" "reachability violation" "connectivity" "safety metric" network configuration evaluation
queries.rationale: Find commonly used operational metrics, validators' output types, and measurement approaches for judging whether a generated configuration is correct/acceptable.

queries.query: prompt injection "prompt-injection" security "LLM" "network operations" adversarial prompts "supply-chain"
queries.rationale: Survey adversarial and security concerns for agentic LLMs used in NetOps, including prompt injection and maliciously crafted inputs that could cause unsafe changes.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop "operator" "LLM" network configuration acceptance "human oversight" "trust" usability studies NetOps
queries.rationale: Gather HCI and operator-trust literature evaluating how human operators interact with, validate, or override model-generated NetOps suggestions.

queries.query: simulation emulation Mininet GNS3 "network emulation" "config execution" testbed "NetOps evaluation"
queries.rationale: Identify simulation/emulation platforms and testbeds used to execute and validate configurations produced by models (for realistic execution-based evaluation).

queries.query: formal synthesis "intent synthesis" "config synthesis" SMT solver "constraint solving" network policy synthesis
queries.rationale: Locate formal synthesis and constraint-based approaches for converting high-level intent to concrete configurations—useful baselines and hybrid architectures.

queries.query: evaluation methodology "benchmark validity" "construct validity" "external validity" LLM benchmarks "operational tasks"
queries.rationale: Search for methodology papers criticizing or analysing benchmark validity, construct validity, and external validity—apply to NetOps benchmarks.

queries.query: related domains "LLM for healthcare" "LLM for finance" "LLM for safety-critical operations" "operational reliability"
queries.rationale: Survey adjacent application areas of agentic LLMs in safety-critical domains to borrow mitigation strategies, evaluation paradigms, and failure analyses.

queries.query: tool-augmented LLMs "tool use" "external API" execution "code interpreter" "LLM with tools" network CLI automation
queries.rationale: Find literature on LLMs that call tools or execute commands (important for agentic NetOps pipelines that interact with network CLIs/APIs).

queries.query: failure modes analysis "LLM failure modes" "systematic error" "hallucination" "misconfiguration" network
queries.rationale: Collect systematic analyses of LLM failure modes and hallucinations, and any domain-specific studies showing how those manifest as misconfigurations in ops.

inclusion_criteria: Works that experimentally evaluate LLMs or generative models on NetOps-relevant tasks (config generation, repair, change planning, or automation).
Papers describing formal/deterministic network configuration verification tools or validators (e.g., Batfish, HSA, Anteater) and their evaluation.
Architecture papers combining generation + verification/repair, tool-assisted LLMs, and agentic/closed-loop AIOps workflows.
Benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites targeted at NetOps or AIOps that include operational metrics or execution-based validation.
Works from 2005–2026 for foundational NetOps verification; prioritize 2018–2026 for LLM/agentic literature and 2020–2026 for LLM surge.
Peer-reviewed conference/journal papers, high-quality arXiv preprints, and reproducible artifacts or public code repositories.
Usability, HCI, or field studies addressing operator interaction, trust, and human-in-the-loop validation in operational settings.
Security/adversarial analyses relevant to agentic LLMs in operations (prompt injection, adversarial inputs, supply-chain risks).
exclusion_criteria: Generic NLP or LLM benchmark papers that only test language understanding without operational NetOps tasks or relevance.
Marketing materials, vendor glossy whitepapers without reproducible technical detail, or unverifiable slides.
Non-technical opinion pieces or blog posts unless they link to technical reports, datasets, or code.
Works outside the date windows unless they are seminal foundational works (allowed for verification/formal-methods history only).
Non-English publications unless an authoritative translation or widely cited summary exists.
Papers that report only knowledge-level QA performance (e.g., 'does model know RFC X') without actionable NetOps generation or validation components.
date_rationale: Two-tier date strategy: include foundational network verification and formal-methods literature from ~2005 onward to capture antecedents (HSA, Anteater-era tools), but prioritize 2018–2026 for methods bridging ML and NetOps and 2020–2026 for LLM/agentic-AI work (rapidly evolving). This balances historical tooling context with the recent LLM-driven literature and ensures coverage of the latest preprints and conference publications up to 2026.
